data.name: OnlinePaymentsIntro
data.value: Let customers pay invoices online through your own Stripe account. Money goes straight to your account; Resgrid never holds it, takes no fee and cannot refund.

data.name: NoConnectionYet
data.value: No Stripe account is connected yet.

data.name: ConnectStripeIntro
data.value: You will sign in to Stripe and allow Resgrid to create payment pages on your account. Resgrid stores your account id only, never your Stripe credentials.

data.name: ConnectAdminOnly
data.value: Only the department administrator can connect or disconnect the Stripe account.

data.name: DisconnectConfirm
data.value: Disconnect the Stripe account? Open pay links stop working and new ones cannot be created until an account is connected again.

data.name: PaymentMethodsHint
data.value: Availability follows what your Stripe account can accept; a method the account cannot take is not offered.

data.name: SuspendedByOperator
data.value: Online payment collection is suspended by the operator in this region. Your connection is kept; no new pay links are offered until it is enabled again.

data.name: OnlinePaymentsFlagOff

data.value: Share this link with the customer; it is printed on the invoice and included in the e-mail. The link stays valid for the pay-link expiry set in billing settings.

data.name: PayOnlineNotOffered

data.value: The unit never reported On Scene on this call, so the line bills the time from the call being logged to its close. Check the quantity before sending.
